title: i don’t understand people connecting religion to this, can someone explain
content: hi, i don’t think i actually dream of mall world but i have dreamt of SOME places in the city (i don’t think i dream of mall world because almost all of these are places you saw irl so i think MY dreams are a coincidence. back to the point, i entered the mall world side of tiktok (which brought me here) and there are people saying that mall world is evil, that these dreams brought them to christianity and to “convert to christianity” because “mall world is a bad place and religion can save you”. i’m european and i am familiar with how absurd americans can be with religion, but im scared that they are right (even if i think it’sjust psychological and, even if there’s more behind it, it does not have anything to do with evil spirits). Even as a christian (catholic), (sorry if i repeat myself) my friend talked about shifting and it doesn’t seem so obsurd since lucid dreaming is a common thing, (i have the same theory about these that i have with mall world, even if there’s something else behind it it’s nothing evil) just assumed this was a similar thing but panicked when i saw christians going against it. If you know anything, could you explain this correlation to me? sorry if some grammar is wrong
